# Reviewing RegScale in the Trust Center Auditor Hub

For FedRAMP. How to make your accounts, sign in, and view RegScale's KSIs, FedRAMP rules, evidence, SDR and CPO. Updated October 27, 2026, 8:15 AM.

## Before you start

- Use Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge on a computer.
- Parts 1 and 2 are for FedRAMP's admin. Part 3 is for everyone at FedRAMP.
- The screenshots come from our test copy, so RegScale shows there as E2E Test Tenant 1.

## Part 1: Set up FedRAMP (FedRAMP's admin)

### Step 1. Sign up

- Go to https://trust.regscale.com/auth/threepao/register?tenant=regscale
  - The page is titled Register your 3PAO firm.
- Firm name: FedRAMP. Primary domain: fedramp.gov.
  - Under Firm details, click the Firm name box and type FedRAMP.
  - Click the Primary domain box and type fedramp.gov.
- Type your first and last name, your email, a username, and a password (twice). Click Register firm.
  - Under Primary admin user, click the First name box and type your first name. Click the Last name box and type your last name.
  - Click the Email box and type your email.
  - Click the Username box and type a username. It must be 3 to 32 characters: letters, numbers, underscores and dashes.
  - Click the Password box and type a password. Click the Confirm password box and type the same password again.
  - Click the blue button at the bottom of the form (Register firm).
  - The sign-in page opens and a message appears at the top right: Registration submitted. Check your email to confirm.
- RegScale approves your sign-up and invites FedRAMP. They will tell you when it is ready.
  - If you sign in before RegScale approves you, the page says "This Trust Center is not active." That is normal. Wait for RegScale's approval email, then sign in again.

### Step 2. Sign in

- Go to https://trust.regscale.com/auth/login
- On the warning screen, click I Acknowledge.
- Type your username and password and click Login.
  - The page is titled Sign in to your account. Click the Username box and type your username.
  - Click the Password box and type your password.
  - Click the blue Login button.
- Passkey: within 7 days of making your account, the site makes you set up a passkey (a security key, Windows Hello, or your phone). Follow the prompts when it asks. After that, click Sign in with a passkey.
  - After you sign in, a yellow box says Passkey required soon: your organization requires a passkey to sign in, and you must set one up within 7 days to avoid being locked out.
  - To set it up: click your name at the top right of the page, then click Account settings.
  - On the Account settings page, find the section Passkeys. Click the Passkey name box and type a name, for example Work laptop.
  - Click the Add a passkey button. Your computer shows a prompt. Follow it (touch your security key, or use your fingerprint, face or PIN).
  - When it works, your passkey appears in a table with the columns Name, Added, Last used and Actions. RegScale also emails you a message titled Security alert: a passkey was added to your Trust Center account.
  - From then on, when you sign in with your username and password, a page titled Two-Factor Authentication opens and says Use your passkey to finish signing in. Click the Sign in with a passkey button and follow the prompt.
  - You can also skip the password: on the Sign in to your account page, click the Sign in with a passkey button at the top.
  - If you do not set up a passkey within 7 days, you will be locked out. Contact RegScale to reset your sign-in.
- Locked out? Contact RegScale to reset your sign-in.

### Step 3. Accept RegScale's invite

- Under Pending invitations, click Accept.
  - If you see 0 pending invitations, RegScale has not sent the invite yet. When it is sent, you get an email titled "regscale invited your firm to attest." Then refresh the page.
  - After you sign in, the Engagements page opens. In the middle of the page, find the box named Pending invitations.
  - Find the invitation from RegScale. Click the blue Accept button at the right end of that row. Do not click Decline.

## Part 2: Add your reviewers (FedRAMP's admin)

### Step 4. Invite a reviewer

- On the left, click Team.
  - In the dark menu on the left side of the page, click Team.

- Click Invite member.
  - On the Team page, click the white Invite member button at the top right of the blue banner. A box titled Invite team member opens.

- Type the reviewer's email and name.
  - In the box, click the Email box and type the reviewer's email.
  - Click the First name box and type the reviewer's first name. Click the Last name box and type the reviewer's last name.
- Role: leave it on Auditor. Pick Firm Admin only for someone who also manages your team.
  - The Role box already says Auditor. Leave it on Auditor.
- Click Send invitation. The invite works for 7 days.
  - Click the blue Send invitation button at the bottom right of the box.

### Step 5. The reviewer makes their account

- The reviewer gets an invite email from trustcenter@regscale.com. Check the spam folder too.
  - The email's subject is: You're invited to join [your firm's name] on Trust Center. It comes from trustcenter@regscale.com.
  - It could go to your spam or junk folder. Be sure to check there if you do not see it in your inbox.
  - The invitation expires 7 days after it is sent. After that, ask your admin for a new invitation.
- Click Accept Invitation in the email.
  - A page titled Accept your invitation opens.
- Pick a username and password and click Create account.
  - Click the Username box and type a username. It must be 3 to 32 characters: letters, numbers, underscores and dashes.
  - Click the Password box and type a password. Click the Confirm password box and type the same password again.
  - Click the blue Create account button.
- Reviewers sign in the same way as Step 2, passkey included.

### Step 6. Give the reviewer RegScale's review

- On the left, click Engagements. On RegScale's engagement, click Assign staff.
  - In the dark menu on the left side of the page, click Engagements.
  - Under Active engagements, find RegScale's engagement. In that row, click the white Assign staff button (it sits between Open workspace and Mark complete). A box titled Assign staff opens.

- Click Assign next to the reviewer, then Done.
  - In the box, find the reviewer's name. Click the blue Assign button at the right end of that row.
  - Click the white Done button at the bottom right of the box.
- Admins see everything. Reviewers only see what they are assigned.
  - If a reviewer signs in and sees "No active engagements," they have not been assigned yet. The admin must do Step 6 for them.

## Part 3: View RegScale's data (everyone)

### Step 7. Open RegScale's workspace

- Go to https://trust.regscale.com/auth/login, click I Acknowledge, and sign in (with your passkey once it is set up).
- Under Active engagements, click Open workspace.
  - On the Engagements page, find RegScale's engagement under Active engagements. Click the blue Open workspace button at the right end of that row.

### Step 8. The tabs

- KSI Worksheet: the KSIs. FedRAMP Rules: the FRRs. SDR Review: the Security Decision Record. CPO Review: the Certification Package Overview.
  - Scroll down the workspace page. Below the summary charts is a row of tabs: My Work, Requests, KSI Worksheet, FedRAMP Rules, AI Audit, Findings, SDR Review, CPO Review, Complete.
- Evidence is inside each KSI and each rule.

### Step 9. KSIs

- Click KSI Worksheet, then click Audit on any KSI.
  - Click the KSI Worksheet tab. A table of KSIs appears.
  - Click the Audit button at the right end of any row. A window opens for that KSI. To close it, click the X at the top right of the window.

- You can read everything. This is view only. Do not click Met or Not Met.
  - On the right side of the window are two buttons named Met and Not Met. Do not click them.
- Left side: the status RegScale reported, how RegScale does it, and every automated check.
  - On the left side of the window, the box What the CSP provided shows the status RegScale reported.
  - The box Implementation narrative shows how RegScale does it. Click Show the full narrative to read all of it.
  - The box Validation data lists every automated check and its result. Click Older at the bottom of the list to see more.

### Step 10. Evidence

- In the same KSI, scroll down to CSP evidence.
  - Scroll down the left side of the window to the box named CSP evidence.
- Click Preview to open a file. Download saves a copy.
  - Each file is one row. Click the Preview button at the right end of the row for the file you want.
  - A window opens with the file name at the top left. The file's contents show inside the window.
  - At the top right of that window are two buttons: Download and Close. Click Download to save a copy of the file to your computer. Click Close to close the window.

### Step 11. FRRs (FedRAMP rules)

- Click FedRAMP Rules, then click Audit on any rule.
  - Close any open window with the X at its top right. Click the FedRAMP Rules tab. A table of rules appears.
  - Click the Audit button at the right end of any row. A window opens for that rule.

- Each rule shows the FedRAMP requirement, how RegScale meets it, and the evidence files.
  - On the left side of the window, the box Requirement shows the FedRAMP rule. The box Implementation narrative shows how RegScale meets it. The box CSP evidence lists the evidence files, each with a Preview button.

### Step 12. SDR

- Click SDR Review. It shows the Security Decision Record as RegScale publishes it.
  - Close any open window with the X at its top right. Click the SDR Review tab.
- Human readable or Machine readable (JSON).
  - Under the heading SDR Review are two buttons: Human readable and Machine readable (JSON). Click the one you want.

### Step 13. CPO

- Click CPO Review. It shows the Certification Package Overview: package ID, services, contacts, assessor, third parties, and where every other part of the package lives.
  - Close any open window with the X at its top right. Click the CPO Review tab.
- Human readable or JSON. Download .md saves a copy.
  - Below the heading Certification Package Overview are two buttons: Human readable and Machine readable (JSON). Click the one you want.
  - To save a copy, click the Download .md button at the top right of that section.

### Sign out

- Top right, click your name, then click Sign out.
  - At the top right of the page, click your name. A menu opens with two items: Account settings and Sign out. Click Sign out. The RegScale Trust Center home page opens.
